claim: Take a clean scenery copy at the right moment: before the first plot when erases run in reverse, at reset not at commit, and after undoing plots if the game captures it with figures drawn.

evidence.text: Main loop erases in exact reverse order of plots.
Reset freezes the clean image; edits after reset belong to the following game update.
Characters are drawn before the room copies to the clean bank, so they are part of the clean copy.
